findings: The x402 directory ecosystem exploded in mid-2026. Circle Agent Marketplace Discovery API (keyless) now returns 1,139+ USDC x402 services across 15+ chains. 402agents.xyz lists 148 agents. x402 Discovery Index (github.com/x402-index) indexes 12,000+ APIs. PayanAgent (github.com/derNif) aggregates 24,000+ live services. Almost nothing is Nano-native. Most directories (minia2a, x402-index, Satring) require an EVM wallet signature or USDC listing to onboard — they index USDC-on-Base services, not Nano ones. So a Nano settlement rail cannot be listed in a USDC directory without misrepresenting it; the legitimate surface for a Nano service is the bridge proxy that converts. Key implication: USDC x402 agents do not publish static Nano-compatible addresses, so 'find one outside Nano' is a communication problem (reach the agent) not an address-scanning problem.
